components.css: .ds-space{font:15px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18283f);background:var(--paper,#fff);border:1px solid var(--blue,#1859c9);border-radius:var(--radius,8px);overflow:hidden;min-width:0;outline:2px solid var(--blue,#1859c9);outline-offset:0;transition:border-color .16s ease-out}.ds-space-heading{display:block;width:100%;font:600 15px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:inherit;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#c9d3df);border-radius:0;text-align:left;padding:17px 18px;background:var(--wash,#e9f0ff);cursor:pointer}.ds-space-heading span{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted,#53647b)}.ds-space-heading h3{font-size:20px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin:4px 0 9px}.ds-space-heading kbd{font:12px/1.5 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;background:#f3f6fa;border:1px solid var(--line,#c9d3df);border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:4px;padding:3px 7px;display:inline-block;white-space:normal}.ds-space-heading:hover{border-color:var(--blue,#1859c9)}.ds-space-heading:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#1859c9);outline-offset:3px}.ds-space-body{padding:7px 18px 12px;min-height:115px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-space{transition:none!important}}

narrative.overview: This document applies only to `home/dot_local/share/yabai-spaces/index.html`. The user selected a light, blue-accented space overview with an inspector. Cool-gray ground, white canvases, navy text, ruled rows, and restrained corners make destinations and source-editing state visible without decorative desktop imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Functional space map and one linked inspector.
Blue selection and actions; textual state and recovery guidance.
System UI controls, monospace shortcuts, flat bordered surfaces.

rules.name: The Visible State Rule
rules.body: Pair selection and operation colors with explicit control or status semantics.

rules.name: The Source Boundary Rule
rules.body: Save, apply, and focus tests remain visibly distinct actions; saving never installs configuration or moves windows.

dos: Do preserve visible labels, focus outlines, selection semantics, and status messages.
Do keep planned spaces separate from read-only live inventory.
Do preserve mobile focus transfer and the return-to-overview control.
donts: Don't attribute this surface's visual identity to the entire dotfiles repository.
Don't collapse save, apply, and focus tests into one action or use color alone to communicate state.
